    "languages": ["fr", "ar"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Coachella ~ 'coach' (English) + 'ella' (Spanish = she); also 'coche' (Spanish = car) + 'ella'",

    "languages": ["en", "es"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Coachella → 'chaco' + 'ella' + 'le'; 'chaco' (Quechua) = hunting ground, 'ella' = she",

    "languages": ["qu", "es"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {

    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2

  {

    "reading": "Moon, circle, beginning, ladder, window, twin flames — a lunar ascent to twin fires.",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],

  {

    "reading": "Reduced to six — the hexagram, the marriage of fire and water, the seal of Solomon.",
